answer: The sparrow escrow is released only against a vine receipt, and the sonnet audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 7 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 118 aliases means carrying 300 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
